title: He Washed Dishes. Now He Runs a $5 Trillion Company
desc:
Jensen Huang scrubbed plates at Denny's as a teenager. Decades later, Nvidia became the first company ever worth $5 trillion.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.

title: At 9, His School Job Was Cleaning Toilets
desc:
Jensen Huang was sent to a strict boarding school in Kentucky at nine. His daily chore? The bathrooms. Here's what it taught him.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: The Most Valuable Company on Earth Started in a Denny's
desc:
Three engineers, one diner booth and a bet on graphics chips. That booth became Nvidia.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Nvidia's First Chip Was a Disaster
desc:
The NV1 tried to do everything at once and almost nobody bought it. Boxes came back to the warehouse. This is how Nvidia nearly died in year two.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

title: Finish the Chip or Lose Your Only Customer?
desc:
Nvidia had one paying customer and a chip nobody wanted. Both options looked like the end. Jensen picked a third one.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: He Told His Biggest Customer to Fire Him
desc:
Jensen Huang walked into Sega, admitted his chip was wrong, and asked them to let Nvidia go. Then he asked for $5 million. They said yes.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Nvidia Had 30 Days of Cash Left
desc:
Layoffs, one chip, one month of payroll. Then the RIVA 128 came out and a million sold in four months.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.

title: How Nvidia Crushed the Company Every Gamer Loved
desc:
3dfx and its Voodoo cards ruled PC gaming. Nvidia shipped a new chip every six months and bought what was left of them by 2000.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Why AI Runs on Graphics Chips (Simple Explanation)
desc:
A CPU is one very smart worker. A GPU is thousands of simple ones working at once. That one difference is why AI runs on Nvidia.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Wall Street Hated This Project. It's Worth Trillions Now
desc:
Nvidia poured money into CUDA for years while the stock fell more than 75%. Investors called it a waste. It became the base of modern AI.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

title: Two Gaming Cards in a Bedroom Changed AI Forever
desc:
In 2012, a small team trained a neural network on two Nvidia gaming cards and smashed the image-recognition contest. AI changed overnight.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

title: He Hand-Delivered OpenAI's First AI Supercomputer
desc:
In 2016 Jensen Huang personally carried Nvidia's first DGX-1 to a small non-profit lab in San Francisco. That lab was OpenAI.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: Nvidia Tried to Buy the Chip Inside Your Phone
desc:
A $40 billion deal for Arm, whose designs sit in almost every smartphone. Regulators in the US, UK and EU objected, and the deal died.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.

title: America Banned Nvidia's Best Chips From China
desc:
The US cut off China's access to Nvidia's top AI chips. Nvidia built slower versions to fit the rules, and the rules kept changing.
Full video on our YouTube channel.

title: How Nvidia Became the First $5 Trillion Company
desc:
A diner booth, a failed chip, a near-bankruptcy and 17 years of CUDA. This is how it all added up.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
